hardware: RTX 3050 Ti Laptop 4 GB; approximately 20 GB RAM

ocr.timing_scope: Sequential runs on the same video. Baseline includes initial reader initialization; optimized run reuses the reader. Both use already downloaded weights.

format_test_scope: Generated English portrait, Vietnamese portrait and Chinese landscape; language hints and transcript references were supplied for region discovery. Short captions last 0.3/0.4 seconds. This is a preservation test, not a broad accuracy benchmark. Vietnamese result was retested on algorithm 12 after the region-discovery fix. English and Chinese format results were measured before the final uncertainty-vote and fuzzy-region fixes.
limitations: Times measure recognition, not complete translation or rendering.
Cache reuse requires the same content and recognition settings.
Cold ASR includes model initialization and alignment; warm ASR still performs real recognition.
No promised speedup on every video; uncertain OCR groups are rescanned at full density.
Accuracy on noisy speech and unseen videos was not measured by these speed tests.
